Name: Startup Programs Manager
Description: View and manage Windows startup programs to improve boot performance and system security.

Params.name: InfoNote
Params.default: View and manage Windows startup programs to improve boot performance and system security.

Params.name: Action
Params.label: Action
Params.description:
**ViewAll**: Show all startup programs.
**ViewEnabled**: Show only enabled startup programs.
**ViewDisabled**: Show only disabled startup programs.
**DisableByName**: Disable specific startup item(s).
**EnableByName**: Enable specific startup item(s).
**ExportList**: Export startup list to CSV file.

Params.name: ItemName
Params.label: Program Name (for Enable/Disable)
Params.description: Name of startup program to enable/disable. Supports partial matching. Use ViewAll first to see exact names.

Params.name: IncludeServices
Params.label: Include Automatic Services
Params.description: Include automatic Windows services in the startup list. Warning: Shows many system services.

Params.name: IncludeTaskScheduler
Params.label: Include Scheduled Tasks
Params.description: Include scheduled tasks that run at logon or startup.

Params.name: ShowDetails
Params.label: Show Detailed Information
Params.description: Show additional details like file path, command line, and registry location.

Params.name: ExportPath
Params.label: Export Folder (CSV will be created)
Params.description: Choose a writable folder. If you select a protected folder (like C:\Windows or Program Files), export may fail unless the toolkit is running as Administrator.

Params.name: SortBy
Params.label: Sort Results By
Params.description: How to sort the startup programs list.
